_about: royer-merge change-scoped checks for markdown-editor-ui (agent-toolbox skills/merge/affected-checks.mjs reads this repo-root file before the toolbox's own). Main ships to Vercel at merge; there is no promotion split, so ui-quality-gate and qa only name the pages for the PR body's QA at promotion list.

checks.name: typecheck
checks._boat: Portable: passed on a boat box at the PR head through run-checks.mjs.

checks.name: lint
checks._boat: Portable: passed on a boat box at the PR head through run-checks.mjs.

checks.name: unit
checks._boat: Portable: passed on a boat box at the PR head through run-checks.mjs.

checks.name: build
checks._boat: Portable: passed on a boat box at the PR head through run-checks.mjs (next build needs no secrets here).

checks.name: own-specs
checks.what: the PR's own added or changed Playwright specs, run against next start after the build
checks._boat: Off boat: playwright.config.ts launches installed Google Chrome (channel: chrome) and serves `npm run start` on a fixed port; the box image has no Chrome. Runs on a Mac lane when a PR adds or changes a spec.

checks.name: ui-quality-gate
checks.what: the UI quality gate on the pages the diff reaches; QA runs it, merges skip it

checks.name: qa
checks.what: independent royer-qa on the PR's own surface

checks.name: qa-gate
checks.what: QA at the head before merge (auth, payments, data, secrets, deploy config)

markdown-editor-ui.setup: [ -d node_modules ] || if [ -f bun.lock ]; then b="${BUN:-$HOME/.bun/bin/bun}"; [ -x "$b" ] || b=$(command -v bun) || { echo 'setup: bun.lock but no bun (set BUN or install ~/.bun/bin/bun)' >&2; exit 1; }; NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG=/dev/null "$b" install --frozen-lockfile > /dev/null; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund > /dev/null 2>&1; fi
markdown-editor-ui._setup: Bun is the package manager (Royer's pick, Oct 27, 2026; packageManager bun@1.4.4, bun.lock). Same string as Answerbar's profile: bun install --frozen-lockfile ignoring ~/.npmrc, npm install on an older branch without bun.lock. Checks call ./node_modules/.bin/<tool> on Node.

boat._setup: Answerbar's box setup: installs the packageManager's Bun (the box image's Bun 1.3.14 can't read bun.lock), then setup runs.
